title: "Quiz — Design the Scenes"
description: "Knowledge check for Module 5."
order: 5
---

## Questions

1. **What is the most important field in a scene definition?**

   a) Location
   b) Characters
   c) Learning outcome
   d) Sound

2. **Which beat in the narrative arc is where the abstraction proves its
   worth?**

   a) Introduction
   b) Discovery
   c) Climax
   d) Resolution

3. **A scene cannot answer "What did I learn about the technical model from this
   scene?" What should you do?**

   a) Add more sound effects
   b) Add more characters
   c) Tighten the scene or cut it
   d) Move it later in the arc

4. **Why should technical storytelling use a narrative arc instead of
   documentation read aloud?**

   a) It makes the story longer.
   b) It guides the listener from curiosity to understanding.
   c) It allows more characters.
   d) It reduces the number of scenes needed.

5. **Where does the technical takeaway fall in the eight-beat arc?**

   a) After the Introduction
   b) Before the Discovery
   c) After the Resolution
   d) Between Challenge and Climax

## Answers

1. c) Learning outcome
2. c) Climax
3. c) Tighten the scene or cut it
4. b) It guides the listener from curiosity to understanding
5. c) After the Resolution
